player_prompt.intro: Umdlali {player_id}. Udlala umdlalo we- 15-Puzzle. Inhloso yalo mdlalo ukuhlela amathayili anenombolo ngokulandelana kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-15, isikhala esingenalutho sitholakala ekhoneni elingezansi kwesokudla. Ukwenza ukunyakaza, ungadonsela ithayili esikhaleni esingenalutho (esimelwe ngombhalo ongaphansi ophindwe kabili, isibonelo __) ngokusebenzisa omunye wemiyalo elandelayo: - 'up': Hambisa ithayili ngaphansi kwesikhala esingenalutho phezulu. - 'down': Hambisa ithayili ngenhla kwesikhala esingenalutho phansi. - 'left': Hambisa ithayili ngakwesokudla kwesikhala esingenalutho ngakwesobunxele. - 'right': Hambisa ithayili ngakwesobunxele kwesikhala esingenalutho ngakwesokudla. Ukuze uthumele ukunyakaza kwakho, thayipha isiqondiso (isibonelo, 'phezulu', 'phansi', 'ngakwesobunxele', noma 'ngakwesokudla') kubakaki abayisikwele, isibonelo [up]. Ukuhlelwa kwamanje kwebhodi kuboniswe ngezansi. Sebenzisa imininingwane yokuxazulula ipha.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomethi yokunyakaza engalungile. Umdlali {player_id} akaphendulanga ngokuqondisa okuvumelekile kubakaki abakwesobunxele.
invalid_move.illegal_move: Ukuthutha okungasebenzi. I-tile ayikwazi ukuthuthwa ngendlela ebekiwe.

outcome.win: Siyakuhalalisela! Umdlali {player_id} uyixazulule ngempumelelo i-Puzzle engu-15.
outcome.turn_limit: Umkhawulo wokuphenduka ufinyelelwe. Imodeli iqede amaphesenti {percent} e-puzzle
